title: Cooling water pump motor, bearing failure after greasing
tests: Blame wording in the tree ('fitter over-greased'); forced deterioration.
summary: A 90 kW cooling water pump motor lost its drive-end bearing three weeks after a PM grease. The bearing had hot, pushed-out grease. The tree's root cause says 'fitter over-greased'. The fix is the system: no grease quantity or interval in the PM, a grease gun that is not metered.

problem.title: Drive-end bearing failure on cooling water pump motor M-5502
problem.site: Alumina refinery, utilities area, Gladstone QLD
problem.whatHappened: Motor M-5502 tripped on high drive-end bearing temperature on 21 Aug 2026, 3 weeks after the PM greasing round. Drive-end bearing was found overheated, grease pushed out of the end cap and the bearing rough. Motor was swapped for a spare.
problem.when: Day shift. 3 weeks after the 6-monthly grease task.
problem.impact: Cooling water duty moved to the standby pump; no production loss. Motor swap and rewind of the bearing seat was needed.
problem.makeModel: 90 kW, 4 pole, 415 V, 1,480 rpm, grease nipples both ends
problem.duty: Drives the cooling water pump on the process cooling circuit, continuous

evidence.title: Drive-end bearing and end cap
evidence.note: Grease packed full in the cavity and pushed out of the cap seal. Bearing discoloured and rough.

evidence.title: PM job card for greasing
evidence.note: Card says 'grease motor bearings 6 monthly'. No quantity, no grease type, no purge procedure.

evidence.title: Grease gun in use
evidence.note: Hand grease gun, not metered. Different gun used on all rounds.

evidence.title: Fitter
evidence.note: Said he pumped until 'it felt full' because the card gave no quantity. No training on small-motor greasing.

tree.text: Drive-end bearing on motor M-5502 overheated and failed

children.text: Bearing cavity over-filled with grease, causing churning and overheating

actions.description: Swap motor M-5502 and send the failed motor for repair

capa.deteriorationReasoning: Over-filling the bearing with grease is damage we caused by method, not normal bearing wear.
corrective: Swap motor and repair the failed one (a1 done)

preventive.what: Greasing job card with grease type, quantity in grams or strokes per bearing, relief path check and run-in
Grease motor bearings by a measured quantity with a metered gun
preventive.interval: every 6 months, starting point to check with the motor maker and bearing size

preventive.what: Bearing temperature and vibration spot check after greasing
preventive.interval: after each greasing and every 3 months

preventive.what: Fit grease relief or automatic lubricator on critical small motors, only if a review supports it
Short hands-on greasing training as part of the system change, not on its own

capa.spares: Hold drive-end bearing set and end cap seal for the 90 kW frame; the spare motor exists so set a min of 1 motor.
capa.rollout: All grease-lubricated motors on the same PM task and the same grease gun routes: check for over-fill symptoms.
